patch_description: Consolidate RY gate parameters from 3 distinct ones (ry_even, ry_odd, ry_mid) back to 2 (ry, ry_mid), reducing distinct parameter count from 6 to 5 to match the best prior design. Then deepen the circuit by adding a second XX-CRX-YY entangling sequence after the existing YY block, maintaining the shared "ent_nn" parameter. This follows the proven pattern that achieved validation_margin_mean of 0.73 and better parameter efficiency. The deeper circuit should improve worst_group_margin robustness while keeping parameter economy optimal.
